errors.text_span: Визуално са представени две линии: една синя, означена като „B2C пазар (в трлн. долара)“
errors.evidence: The blue series representing the 'B2C пазар' is an area chart, not a line chart.
The chart does not have any markers for the blue area. The legend shows a blue square as a key for the area color, not as a marker shape.
The orange line representing 'Ръст' (Growth) does not have any markers. The description hallucinates the presence of round markers.
The chart shows the 28% growth value corresponding to the year 2018, not 2017. There is no growth value shown for 2017.
The description incorrectly states that the peak growth was 26% in 2019. The highest growth rate shown on the chart is 28% in 2018.
